sources.summary: Building an AI prototype is easy, but operating autonomous agents at scale requires production-grade tooling. Salesforce Agentforce bridges the gap from "vibe coding" to enterprise reliability by combining synthetic stress-testing, real-time optimization, dynamic agentic UIs, and deterministic guardrails—as proven by Southwest Airlines' 7x ROI. The post Salesforce Agentforce: Bridging the Enterprise AI Gap from ‘Vibe Coding’ to Battle-Tested Orchestration appeared first on MarkTechPost .
